sonnet.problem: The joke refers to "the Millers" and a "shiny new stamper" without saying who the Millers are. A baker who doesn't know his backstory can't tell who they are or why his spot was taken.
sonnet.rule: Bakers may not know anything about his story. Anything from his backstory, like the drawer, the Millers, the shiny new stamper or the angel, is said in the line itself
